text:
For hotel conversions in the **Caribbean and Latin America (CALA)**, owners typically begin with conversion-friendly **collection or “soft” brands**, followed by conventional full-service brands if the building can economically satisfy stricter standards.

### Most commonly considered

| Hotel company | Brands typically evaluated | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio** | Independent urban hotels, historic properties and distinctive resorts. Marriott specifically positions its collection brands as platforms for independent hotels; both have been used for Caribbean conversions. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection by Hilton**, sometimes **Tapestry Collection by Hilton** | Curio is firmly upper-upscale and particularly relevant for distinctive resorts and lifestyle hotels. Tapestry is officially upscale but frequently enters the same conversion discussions for assets with somewhat lower positioning or renovation budgets. Conversions represented nearly 60% of Hilton’s 2024 CALA openings. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/uploads/2024/04/HLT.Q1-CORP-FactSheet-APR2024.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, occasionally **Destination by Hyatt** | Independent upper-upscale or luxury resorts and landmark urban hotels that need substantial brand flexibility. Hyatt identifies Unbound as an upper-upscale/luxury collection competing with Autograph and Curio. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG Hotels & Resorts** | **voco**, **Hotel Indigo**, sometimes **Crowne Plaza** | voco is especially conversion-oriented, with flexible standards and relatively rapid integration. Hotel Indigo suits design-led neighborhood or resort properties; Crowne Plaza fits larger business, meetings and convention hotels. IHG has recently signed multiple voco conversions in Mexico. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/voco-hotels?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **MGallery Collection**, sometimes **Pullman** | MGallery is an upper-upscale collection brand suited to boutique, historic and locally distinctive hotels. Accor explicitly prioritizes conversions for its collection brands and already has MGallery representation in Latin America. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts** | **Registry Collection Hotels** | Upper-upscale soft-brand option for independent luxury-leaning resorts, including all-inclusive properties. Wyndham identifies Registry as an upper-upscale soft brand and has examples in Mexico. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/upscale-lifestyle-hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Minor Hotels** | **NH Collection** | Particularly relevant in Latin American capital cities and established commercial markets because of NH’s regional recognition and operating footprint. NH Collection is generally positioned in the upper-upscale/premium segment. ([costar.com](https://www.costar.com/article/1707667081/nh-hotels-brands-emerge-strong-after-owner-transition?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice/Radisson Americas** | **Radisson Blu**, **Radisson Individuals** | Selective alternatives where Radisson recognition is meaningful. Radisson Blu is upper-upscale, while Radisson Individuals offers a flexible affiliation model with lower conversion costs. Choice controls these brands in Latin America and the Caribbean. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/development-opportunities/our-brands?utm_source=openai)) |

### Conventional brands also considered

Where the physical plant already closely matches brand standards, the shortlist may also include:

- **Delta Hotels by Marriott** — frequently used for full-service conversions. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/ResourceFiles/fdd-document/2025-delta-fdd-3-31-2025.pdf?utm_source=openai))  
- **Renaissance, Sheraton or Westin**
- **Hilton Hotels & Resorts or DoubleTree by Hilton**
- **Hyatt Regency or Hyatt Centric**
- **Crowne Plaza or Pullman**
- **Radisson Blu**

These generally require more standardized guestrooms, public areas, food-and-beverage facilities, meeting space and operating programs than the collection brands.

### Practical “first-call” shortlist

For a typical independent upper-upscale CALA hotel or resort, the initial conversion comparison would most often be:

1. **Autograph Collection**
2. **Curio Collection**
3. **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
4. **Tribute Portfolio**
5. **voco**
6. **MGallery**
7. **Registry Collection**
8. **NH Collection**, especially in South American urban markets

The final fit depends heavily on whether the property is **urban or resort, European-plan or all-inclusive, branded residential or hotel-only**, and on the required property-improvement-plan investment. Segment classifications also vary slightly by company: for example, Tapestry and voco may be called “upscale” or “premium” by their parent companies while competing with upper-upscale conversions in particular CALA markets.
